description: Nikon D200 digital camera: normalized R, G and B channel spectral sensitivities (400-720 nm, 10 nm steps) from the RIT Camera Spectral Sensitivity Database (Jiang et al. 2013); plus the transmission of the camera's internal UV/IR-cut ('hot mirror') filter as measured by Kolari Vision on filters removed during full-spectrum conversions.
facility_description: Digital cameras (DSLRs, mirrorless, compact, industrial, cinema and phone cameras) whose RGB channel spectral sensitivities or internal IR/UV-cut filter transmissions have been measured.
notes: RGB curves checked this session: NJM values are identical (max abs diff 0) to the 'Nikon D200' entry of http://www.gujinwei.org/research/camspec/camspec_database.txt. Block band: Kolari page has a chart titled 'Nikon D200 ICF Transmission' (image chart only; the NJM curve is a digitization). Licence set to the stricter source (Kolari: no redistribution grant) because the Block band comes from Kolari; the RGB bands alone are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (RIT).

licence.terms: "We make no garuntees on the accuracy of this data, provided as a reference only." (no redistribution grant; Kolari Vision terms-and-conditions page covers user submissions only)
